observations: Three photos show two PlayStation 5 consoles with custom red and black Spider-Man themed skins, each with a matching controller.
The consoles are standing upright on a wooden table, with a TV screen and a neon clock visible in the background.
The skin design features a white spider logo and red/black web-like patterns.
The brand 'AL-AMIN ONLINE CONCEPTS' is visible on the skin and in the background signage.
No visible model labels, serial numbers, or official PlayStation branding on the consoles themselves.
The seller claims 'UK refurbished Ps5 phat, fully jailbreak, software version 10.0, games installed'.
No photos of the console's front, ports, or internal components are provided.
No photos of the screen, power button, or any system interface are shown.
